details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: revenue growth drivers (S2) are clearly presented, followed by offsetting expense increases (S3-S4), resulting profit declines (S5-S7), and supporting operational metrics (S12-S14). The summary maintains consistent cause-effect relationships throughout (e.g., higher costs compressing margins). Organizational flow is logical, moving from revenue to expenses to profitability metrics, then operational details and finally strategic actions. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all numerical relationships are presented as comparative changes rather than implying exhaustive additive components. The concluding statement (S17) effectively synthesizes the main themes without introducing new contradictions.
